title: Glessner's 18th Street wall: one granite course an inch lower
items: Glessner House's 22nd granite course is now its printed 8½ inches, not the 9½ copied in error, so the top course and the stone cap along 18th Street sit an inch lower. The second-floor corridor windows on 18th Street, and the tall window over the great arch, now have their heads an inch lower too, at the course they were set on. It is a small change: one inch, on the wall you see from 18th Street.
